qvix_regime.caveat: Index-vol QVIX (no single-stock options in A-shares); read as a market regime, not a per-stock signal. China's positive return-vol link inverts the US 'high VIX = fear'.
qvix_regime.caveat_zh: 指数波动率 QVIX（A 股无个股期权）；为市场区制而非个股信号。中国正的收益-波动相关性使其与美式“高 VIX=恐慌”相反。
